trajectory_feature: Temporal mean of 48D frozen actual states minus constant-trajectory control states
change_feature: 48D controlled state at first assessment minus last baseline, identical to the existing probe definition
scaling: Per-coordinate mean/SD on the label-blind sampled atlas; SD floor 0.0001; transductive exploration

clustering.method: HDBSCAN on standardized original 48D, never on the 2D layout

scope: Existing observed data only; unsupervised transductive exploration, no neural retraining, held-out validation or phenomenon classification. Context themes and optical labels never fit UMAP or clusters. InSAR phase is a different measurement domain and is excluded.
